title: The Statue Garden
text: A garden is full of statues, each a traveler caught mid-step: a man with a pack, a woman glancing back, a child reaching for a hand. Their clothes are real, rotting on the stone. Every face is smooth, blank stone.

options.label: Search the statues' packs; they have no use for coin now.

outcomes.text: Stone purses hold coins, and one holds a carved key.
One statue is not a statue.

options.label: The wisest puts an ear to one to learn what turned them.

outcomes.text: Something is still alive in there. It tells you the way out, then begs you to stay.

options.label: Hurry through without looking at the faces, before you join them.

outcomes.text: You get out without becoming statues, though the stone dust has got into everyone's joints.
